requirements.AI-001.title: Business ownership
requirements.AI-001.description: AI applications must have an identified business owner.
requirements.AI-002.title: Sensitive information
requirements.AI-002.description: Sensitive or confidential information must not be submitted to an AI system without appropriate controls.
requirements.AI-003.title: Human oversight
requirements.AI-003.description: AI-generated outputs used for business decisions must have appropriate human oversight.
requirements.AI-004.title: Logging & monitoring
requirements.AI-004.description: AI applications must maintain appropriate logging and monitoring.
requirements.AI-005.title: Access controls
requirements.AI-005.description: AI applications must have defined access controls.
requirements.AI-006.title: Third-party assessment
requirements.AI-006.description: Third-party AI models and services must undergo appropriate security assessment.
requirements.AI-007.title: Intended use & limitations
requirements.AI-007.description: AI applications must have documented intended use and limitations.
requirements.AI-008.title: High-risk review
requirements.AI-008.description: High-risk AI use cases must undergo additional review before deployment.
scenarios.support.title: Customer support
scenarios.support.subtitle: Customer data · Hosted LLM
scenarios.support.text: A customer support team wants to use an LLM to summarize customer conversations and suggest responses to support agents. The system will process customer names, account information, support tickets, and conversation history. A human support agent will review the generated response before sending it to the customer. The application will use a third-party hosted LLM API.
scenarios.security.title: Security operations
scenarios.security.subtitle: Security logs · Analyst review
scenarios.security.text: The cybersecurity team wants to deploy an internal AI assistant that can analyze security alerts and recommend investigation steps. The assistant will have access to internal security logs and selected threat intelligence sources. Security analysts will review recommendations before taking action. The system will be deployed within the organization's cloud environment.
scenarios.hr.title: Employee decisions
scenarios.hr.subtitle: HR information · High impact
scenarios.hr.text: HR wants to use an AI system to analyze employee performance information and automatically recommend employees for promotion. The system will process employee performance records and HR information. HR intends for the AI system's recommendation to be used as the primary input into promotion decisions.
sample.summary: Human review is a strong starting point. Before deployment, clarify how customer information is protected and who is accountable for the service.
sample.risk_rationale: Illustrative medium-risk rating because sensitive customer information is processed with human review. A governance reviewer must confirm the classification and data controls.
sample.next_actions.1: Confirm data controls and complete the provider security assessment.
sample.next_actions.2: Document access, monitoring, limitations, and the required governance review.
sample.follow_up_questions.0: What customer information will leave the organization?
sample.follow_up_questions.1: Has the model provider completed a security assessment?
sample.follow_up_questions.2: Who owns the application and approves it for deployment?
sample.AI-001.explanation: The team is named, but an accountable business owner is not identified.
sample.AI-001.recommendation: Assign a named business owner before deployment.
sample.AI-002.explanation: Sensitive customer information is involved. Data protection controls are not described.
sample.AI-002.recommendation: Confirm data minimization, redaction, retention, and provider data-handling controls.
sample.AI-002.evidence.0: The system will process customer names, account information, support tickets, and conversation history.
sample.AI-003.explanation: A person reviews each customer-facing response before use.
sample.AI-003.recommendation: Document reviewer responsibilities and escalation procedures.
sample.AI-003.evidence.0: A human support agent will review the generated response before sending it to the customer.
sample.AI-004.explanation: The scenario does not describe logging or monitoring.
sample.AI-004.recommendation: Define audit events, retention, redaction, and monitoring responsibilities.
sample.AI-005.explanation: User authentication and authorization are not described.
sample.AI-005.recommendation: Define approved users and least-privilege access.
sample.AI-006.explanation: A third-party service is involved, but its assessment status is unknown.
sample.AI-006.recommendation: Complete the provider security assessment and review contractual safeguards.
sample.AI-006.evidence.0: The application will use a third-party hosted LLM API.
sample.AI-007.explanation: The intended task is described, but documented limitations are not provided.
sample.AI-007.recommendation: Document allowed uses, known limitations, and prohibited uses.
sample.AI-007.evidence.0: A customer support team wants to use an LLM to summarize customer conversations and suggest responses to support agents.
sample.AI-008.explanation: Customer financial information warrants risk review; no review outcome is provided.
sample.AI-008.recommendation: Have governance determine the risk classification and required review before deployment.
